**@cv** commented (https://github.com/cv/pi-action/issues/46#issuecomment-6817397987):

Agree with the suggestions. Grouping by turn might be too coarse, however - aren't we doing only one turn per workflow run? Looking through existing sessions, how should we change the grouping for maximum log-following comfort?

We also post a blurb to the summary ('This conversation is stored in git on...'), which only arrives once the workflow is done running. It would be better to have this information directly in the same log, which is the only thing visible as the workflow is in progress.

_(pi-action posts your final response as a comment here. Don't also post it with `gh`.)_
